reference: Six-model stoppage consensus, CSV SHA256 dac48e6be66f4395089cae4eee3cfb5daeadcd7963480f399fe079d871be534c; preserved under data/control_precision_v1/.
intent: Improve primary interval score using finer ownership endpoints while preserving every reference D/live decision.
feedback_loop: The selected buffered seed42 has 3 of 6 short true possessions matched at IoU>=.5. Require at least 4; diagnostics use public labels, inference never does.
hypotheses_ranked: The 51-frame older proposal envelope extends short ownership runs. Fine conditional ownership from the same older model should improve existing short endpoints without changing topology or D.
Probability averaging dilutes sharp ownership evidence. Mean log likelihood from the older and fast heads should improve endpoints relative to mean probabilities under the same constraints.

The missing short controls have no correct ownership signal before gating. Aggregate raw-head accuracy on short true runs will distinguish absent model evidence from a decoder-only failure; topology-preserving methods cannot create a missed run.
data: Existing local padded observations and cached OOF probabilities only; no new labels, media, raw tracking output, hosted processing or frame patches. No model fitting or calibration in this screen.
inference: Decode the unchanged six-model reference first. Eligible islands have 8..125 frames and opposite-team live neighbors on both sides. Only their two adjacent boundaries may move, by at most radius frames. Joint dynamic programming keeps the entire original run-label sequence, every D frame, at least 8 frames for each eligible island, and positive length for other runs. Boundaries cannot cross. Equal likelihood prefers the reference positions. Evidence is conditional H/A probability from the chosen original head(s); joint mean averages probabilities, joint log averages log probabilities, followed by optional centered 11-frame averaging in the corresponding space. Evidence never crosses decode blocks.
confirmation: Freeze at most one unchanged finalist and reference before seeds43/44. Compare all three protocols and seeds42/43/44 with official scorer and shared inference parity.

promotion.all_pairs: Stitched spellF1, MacroF1, mean short IoU and number of short IoU>=.5 matches must not regress. No previously mostly recovered short run may become mostly missed. D masks must be identical.
promotion.each_buffered_seed: Primary spellF1 gain >=.04 and at least one additional short IoU>=.5 match.
promotion.selection: Among screen finalists that satisfy all available gates prefer the larger minimum primary gain across protocols, then mean short IoU, then smaller radius; otherwise preserve the selected model. Report all block regressions.

limitations: Adaptive same-fixture development on 17 repeatedly inspected public possessions. The eight variants are dependent comparisons, not independent evidence. A pass does not establish maximum score or private/generalization accuracy.
